name: Pocket Network
summary: Decentralized network where developers publish HTTP data services and get paid onchain per request by AI agents and MCP clients; its Agentic Portal lists the services agents can call, and paid calls go over x402.

key_number.unit: calls in 30 days (CDP Bazaar quality data)

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (20:24-20:59 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with Pocket Network or YourAITools is involved.

claims.statement: https://pocket.network is the official site: it is the address YourAITools lists for Pocket Network and the site answers there (page title "Pocket Network — Publish Data Services, Get Paid by AI Agents").
claims.quote: Pocket Network — Publish Data Services, Get Paid by AI Agents

claims.statement: The site serves real content without sign-in (HTTP 200). It also publishes an llms.txt for agents.
claims.quote: Publish your API to Pocket Network and get paid on-chain for every request from AI agents and MCP clients. Build with Claude, deploy with PSM4Win, list on the Agentic Portal.

claims.statement: Operator's own description: Publish your API to Pocket Network and get paid on-chain for every request from AI agents and MCP clients.
claims.quote: Publish your API to Pocket Network and get paid on-chain for every request from AI agents and MCP clients.

claims.statement: Operated by Pocket Network Foundation (Cayman Islands foundation company), per the site's terms of use.
claims.quote: Pocket Network Foundation, a Cayman Island foundation company headquartered in George Town, Cayman Island

claims.statement: Public documentation for agents and developers.
Public code repository linked from the official site.

Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid POST to https://agent.pocket.network/v1/meadow answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Base; asset USDC; price 0.005 USDC; payTo Base 0xF732ea490c5766071785a2310523f7fA2CEbB829). YourAITools lists the price as $0.005. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works.
methods: unpaid POST https://agent.pocket.network/v1/meadow (HTTP 402, header:payment-required; no payment header sent)

claims.statement: Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (the CDP facilitator's discovery index) lists 117 resource(s) on this vendor's domain for the payTo address(es) we observed, with 55,387 calls in the last 30 days as reported by CDP (largest single resource: 35 unique payers; payers cannot be de-duplicated across resources). These are the facilitator's counts, not an Atlas observation of settlements.
